# Jinbeh Japanese Restaurant

> Family-owned Japanese hibachi and sushi restaurant in Frisco and Lewisville, TX since 1988.

## About

Jinbeh Japanese Restaurant is a family-owned Japanese dining destination in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. We specialize in teppanyaki hibachi grilled tableside and hand-crafted sushi. Our two locations in Frisco and Lewisville, Texas have been serving authentic Japanese cuisine for over 38 years.

## Locations

### Frisco
- Address: 2693 Preston Rd Suite 1040, Frisco, TX 75034
- Phone: (214) 619-1200
- Near Stonebriar Centre Mall
- Website: https://jinbeh.com/frisco

### Lewisville
- Address: 2440 S Stemmons Fwy #A, Lewisville, TX 75067
- Phone: (214) 488-2224
- Off I-35E near Vista Ridge Mall
- Website: https://jinbeh.com/lewisville

## Services

- **Dine-In Hibachi**: Teppanyaki experience with live chef performance
- **Sushi Bar**: Fresh sushi rolls, sashimi, omakase
- **Happy Hour**: Daily drink and appetizer specials
- **Private Dining & Events**: Birthdays, anniversaries, corporate events
- **Catering**: Hibachi and sushi catering for offsite events
- **Takeout & Delivery**: Online ordering available
- **Gift Cards**: Available for purchase
